description: TypeScript declaration file for the Node.js 'punycode' module, providing methods for encoding and decoding Punycode strings, as well as converting domain names between Unicode and ASCII representations.

methods.name: function decode(string: string): string; decode
methods.description: Converts a Punycode string of ASCII-only characters to the equivalent Unicode string.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Converts a Unicode string to a Punycode string of ASCII characters.

methods.name: toUnicode
methods.description: Converts a domain name containing Punycode-encoded characters into Unicode.

methods.name: toASCII
methods.description: Converts a Unicode domain name to its ASCII Punycode representation.
